title_en: Product Quality Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is formulated for the purposes of strengthening the supervision and administration of product quality, improving product quality, clarifying product quality liability, protecting the legitimate rights and interests of consumers, and maintaining the social and economic order.

Article 2 Any entity engaged in production and sale activities within the territory of the People's Republic of China must comply with this Law.
For the purposes of this Law, 'product' means a product that is processed or manufactured and intended for sale.
Construction works are not subject to the provisions of this Law; however, where construction materials, building components, and equipment used in construction works fall within the scope of products as prescribed in the preceding paragraph, the provisions of this Law shall apply.

Article 3 Producers and sellers shall establish and improve internal product quality management systems, and strictly implement job quality standards, quality responsibilities, and corresponding assessment methods.
Article 4 Producers and sellers shall bear product quality liability in accordance with the provisions of this Law.

Article 5 It is prohibited to forge or fraudulently use quality marks such as certification marks; it is prohibited to forge the origin of products, or forge or fraudulently use the name and address of another manufacturer; it is prohibited to adulterate or mix impurities into products being produced or sold, or to pass off fake products as genuine, or defective products as high-quality ones.

Article 6 The State encourages the promotion of scientific quality management methods and the adoption of advanced science and technology, and encourages enterprises to have their product quality meet and exceed trade standards, national standards, and international standards.
Units and individuals that have achieved remarkable results in advanced product quality management and whose products have reached internationally advanced levels shall be awarded.

Article 7 People's governments at all levels shall incorporate the improvement of product quality into their plans for national economic and social development, strengthen overall planning and organizational leadership for product quality work, guide and urge producers and sellers to strengthen product quality management and improve product quality, and organize relevant departments to take measures according to law to stop acts violating the provisions of this Law in the production and sale of products, thus ensuring the implementation of this Law.

Article 8 The market supervision and administration department of the State Council shall be in charge of the supervision of product quality nationwide. Relevant departments of the State Council shall be responsible for product quality supervision within their respective functions and duties.
Market supervision and administration departments of local people's governments at or above the county level shall be in charge of product quality supervision within their respective administrative regions. Relevant departments of local people's governments at or above the county level shall be responsible for product quality supervision within their respective functions and duties.
Where laws provide otherwise concerning the supervisory departments for product quality, those provisions shall prevail.

Article 9 No staff member of a people's government or any other State organ may abuse his power, neglect his duty, engage in malpractices for personal gain, or harbor or connive at acts violating the provisions of this Law in the production and sale of products that occur within his region or department, or obstruct or interfere with the investigation and punishment according to law of acts violating the provisions of this Law in the production and sale of products.
Where a local people's government at any level or any other State organ harbors or connives at acts violating the provisions of this Law in the production and sale of products, the legal liability of the principal responsible persons shall be investigated according to law.

Article 10 Any unit or individual shall have the right to report acts violating the provisions of this Law to the market supervision and administration department or other relevant departments.
The market supervision and administration department and relevant departments shall keep the reporter confidential and give rewards in accordance with the provisions of the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government.
Article 11 No unit or individual may exclude qualified products produced by enterprises outside their own region or system from entering their region or system.
Article 12 Products shall be inspected and found to be up to standard, and no substandard products may be passed off as up-to-standard products.

Article 13 Industrial products that may endanger human health or the safety of persons or property must comply with the national standards or trade standards for the protection of human health and the safety of persons and property; where no such national or trade standards have been formulated, such products must meet the requirements for the protection of human health and the safety of persons and property.
It is prohibited to produce or sell industrial products that do not conform to the standards and requirements for the protection of human health and the safety of persons and property. Specific administrative measures shall be formulated by the State Council.

Article 14 The State shall, on the basis of internationally accepted quality management standards, promote a certification system for enterprise quality systems. Enterprises may, on a voluntary basis, apply to certification bodies that are recognized by the market supervision and administration department of the State Council or by departments authorized by the said department for certification of their quality systems. Where an enterprise passes the certification, the certification body shall issue an enterprise quality system certification certificate.
The State shall, by reference to advanced international product standards and technical requirements, promote a product quality certification system. Enterprises may, on a voluntary basis, apply to certification bodies that are recognized by the market supervision and administration department of the State Council or by departments authorized by the said department for product quality certification. Where an enterprise passes the certification, the certification body shall issue a product quality certification certificate and permit the enterprise to use the product quality certification mark on its products or their packaging.

Article 15 The State shall implement a system of supervision and inspection of product quality, mainly through random checks. Random checks shall be conducted on products that may endanger human health or the safety of persons and property, on major industrial products that affect the national economy and the people's livelihood, and on products that consumers and relevant organizations have reported as having quality problems. Samples for random checks shall be randomly selected from products on the market or from products awaiting sale in the finished product warehouses of enterprises. The work of supervision and random checks shall be planned and organized by the market supervision and administration department of the State Council. Market supervision and administration departments of local people's governments at or above the county level may also organize supervision and random checks within their respective administrative regions. Where laws provide otherwise concerning the supervision and inspection of product quality, those provisions shall prevail.
For products that have been subjected to national supervision and random checks, local authorities may not conduct repeated random checks; for products that have been subjected to random checks by a higher-level authority, lower-level authorities may not conduct repeated random checks.
When necessary for supervision and random checks, products may be tested. The number of samples taken for testing shall not exceed the reasonable needs of testing, and no testing fees may be charged to the person under inspection. The expenses required for testing in supervision and random checks shall be disbursed in accordance with the provisions of the State Council.
Where a producer or seller disagrees with the result of a random check test, it may, within 15 days from the date of receipt of the test result, apply for a re-test to the market supervision and administration department that conducted the supervision and random check or to its superior department. The market supervision and administration department that accepts the application for re-test shall make a re-test conclusion.
Article 16 No producer or seller may refuse product quality supervision and inspection conducted according to law.

Article 17 Where a product that has been subject to supervision and random checks in accordance with this Law fails to meet quality standards, the market supervision and administration department that conducted the supervision and random check shall order the producer or seller to rectify within a specified time limit. If no rectification is made within the time limit, the market supervision and administration department of the people's government at or above the provincial level shall make a public announcement; if, after the announcement and a re-inspection, the product still fails to meet quality standards, the producer or seller shall be ordered to suspend business for rectification within a specified time limit; if, after the expiration of the rectification period and a re-inspection, the product quality still fails to meet standards, the business license shall be revoked.
Where a product subject to supervision and random checks has serious quality problems, the relevant provisions of Chapter V of this Law shall apply for punishment.

Article 19 A product quality inspection institution must possess the necessary testing conditions and capabilities, and may undertake product quality inspection work only after passing the assessment by the market supervision and administration department of a people's government at or above the provincial level or by a department authorized by it. Where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise concerning product quality inspection institutions, those provisions shall prevail.

Article 20 A social intermediary institution engaged in product quality inspection or certification must be established according to law and may not have a subordinate relationship or any other interest relationship with an administrative organ or any other State organ.

Article 21 Product quality inspection institutions and certification institutions must, according to law and in accordance with relevant standards, issue inspection results or certification certificates objectively and impartially.
Product quality certification institutions shall, in accordance with state provisions, conduct post-certification follow-up inspections on products permitted to use certification marks; for those that do not meet the certification standards but use the certification marks, they shall require them to make corrections; if the circumstances are serious, they shall revoke their qualification to use the certification marks.

Article 22 Consumers have the right to inquire with the producers or sellers of products about product quality issues; to lodge complaints with the market supervision and administration departments and relevant departments, and the departments that accept the complaints shall handle them.

Article 23 Social organizations for the protection of consumers' rights and interests may, with respect to product quality issues reported by consumers, suggest that the relevant departments handle them, and support consumers in prosecuting claims for damages caused by product quality defects in the People's Court.

Article 24 The market supervision and administration departments of the State Council and of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall periodically publish announcements on the quality status of products they have supervised and inspected through random checks.

Article 25 The market supervision and administration departments or other state organs, as well as product quality inspection institutions, shall not recommend producers' products to the public; they shall not participate in product business activities by means of supervising manufacture, supervising sales, or other means.

Article 40 Where a sold product falls under any of the following circumstances, the seller shall be responsible for repair, replacement, or refund; if losses are caused to the consumer who purchased the product, the seller shall compensate for the losses:
(1) The product does not possess the performance for use it should have and no prior explanation was given;
(2) The product does not conform to the product standards indicated on the product or its packaging;
(3) The product does not conform to the quality status indicated by means such as product descriptions or physical samples.
After the seller has undertaken repair, replacement, refund, or compensation for losses in accordance with the preceding paragraph, if the responsibility lies with the producer or with another seller who supplied the product to the seller (hereinafter referred to as the supplier), the seller shall have the right to seek recourse from the producer or the supplier.
If the seller fails to provide repair, replacement, refund, or compensation for losses in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph, the market supervision and administration department shall order the seller to make corrections.
Where there are different stipulations in the sales contracts or work contracts concluded between producers, between sellers, or between producers and sellers, the contract parties shall execute in accordance with the contract stipulations.

Article 42 Where a product defect caused by the seller's fault results in personal injury or damage to other property, the seller shall bear compensation liability.
If the seller cannot identify the producer of the defective product nor the supplier of the defective product, the seller shall bear compensation liability.

Article 43 Where a defect in a product causes personal injury or damage to other property, the victim may claim compensation from the producer of the product, or may claim compensation from the seller of the product. If the responsibility lies with the producer and the seller has paid compensation, the seller shall have the right to seek recourse from the producer. If the responsibility lies with the seller and the producer has paid compensation, the producer shall have the right to seek recourse from the seller.

Article 44 Where a defect in a product causes personal injury to the victim, the infringer shall compensate for medical expenses, nursing expenses during the treatment period, reduced income due to lost working time, and other expenses; if disability is caused, the infringer shall also pay expenses for self-help devices for the disabled person, living subsidies, disability compensation, and necessary living expenses for persons supported by the disabled person; if the victim is killed, the infringer shall also pay funeral expenses, death compensation, and necessary living expenses for persons supported by the deceased before death.
Where a defect in a product causes property damage to the victim, the infringer shall restore the property to its original condition or compensate for the loss at a discounted price. If the victim suffers other substantial losses as a result, the infringer shall compensate for those losses.

Article 45 The limitation of action for claiming compensation for damages caused by a defect in a product shall be two years, counting from the date when the party knows or should know that its rights and interests were injured.
The right to claim compensation for damages caused by a defect in a product shall be lost upon the expiration of ten years from the delivery of the defective product that caused the damage to the original consumer; however, this shall not apply if the express safety use period has not yet expired.

Article 46 For the purposes of this Law, "defect" means an unreasonable risk existing in a product that endangers the safety of persons or other property; where the product has national or industry standards for safeguarding human health and safety of persons or property, "defect" means non-compliance with such standards.

Article 47 Where a civil dispute arises due to product quality, the parties may resolve it through negotiation or mediation. If the parties are unwilling to resolve through negotiation or mediation, or if negotiation or mediation fails, they may apply to an arbitration institution for arbitration in accordance with the agreement of all parties; if the parties have not reached an arbitration agreement or the arbitration agreement is invalid, they may directly file a prosecution in a People's Court.
Article 48 An arbitration institution or a People's Court may entrust a product quality inspection institution as specified in Article 19 of this Law to inspect the relevant product quality.

Article 49 Where a person produces or sells products that do not conform to the national standards or industry standards for safeguarding human health and safety of persons or property, the production or sale shall be ordered to cease, the illegally produced or sold products shall be confiscated, and a fine of not less than the value of the illegally produced or sold products (including products already sold and unsold, the same below) and not more than three times that value shall also be imposed; if there are illegal gains, the illegal gains shall also be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, the business license shall be revoked; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 50 Where a person adulterates or mixes impurities into products, passes off fake products as genuine, passes off defective products as high-quality, or passes off substandard products as standard products, the production or sale shall be ordered to cease, the illegally produced or sold products shall be confiscated, and a fine of not less than 50% of the value of the illegally produced or sold products and not more than three times that value shall also be imposed; if there are illegal gains, the illegal gains shall also be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, the business license shall be revoked; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 51 Where a person produces products that are expressly eliminated by the state, or sells products that are expressly eliminated by the state and whose sale is stopped, the production or sale shall be ordered to cease, the illegally produced or sold products shall be confiscated, and a fine of not more than the value of the illegally produced or sold products shall also be imposed; if there are illegal gains, the illegal gains shall also be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, the business license shall be revoked.

Article 52 Where a person sells products that are expired or deteriorated, the sale shall be ordered to cease, the illegally sold products shall be confiscated, and a fine of not more than two times the value of the illegally sold products shall also be imposed; if there are illegal gains, the illegal gains shall also be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, the business license shall be revoked; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 53 Where a person falsifies the place of origin of a product, falsifies or fraudulently uses the factory name or factory address of another person, or falsifies or fraudulently uses quality marks such as certification marks, the person shall be ordered to make corrections, the illegally produced or sold products shall be confiscated, and a fine of not more than the value of the illegally produced or sold products shall also be imposed; if there are illegal gains, the illegal gains shall also be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, the business license shall be revoked.

Article 54 Where the product marking does not conform to the provisions of Article 27 of this Law, the person shall be ordered to make corrections; where the marking on packaged products does not conform to the provisions of subparagraphs (4) and (5) of Article 27 of this Law and the circumstances are serious, the production or sale shall be ordered to cease, and a fine of not more than 30% of the value of the illegally produced or sold products shall be imposed; if there are illegal gains, the illegal gains shall also be confiscated.

Article 55 Where a seller sells a product the sale of which is prohibited under Articles 49 through 53 of this Law, if it has sufficient evidence to prove that it did not know that the product was prohibited for sale and truthfully states the source of the product, the punishment may be mitigated or commuted.

Article 56 Whoever rejects the supervision and inspection of product quality conducted according to law shall be given a warning and be ordered to make corrections; if it refuses to make corrections, it shall be ordered to suspend operations for rectification; if the circumstances are especially serious, its business license shall be revoked.

Article 57 Where a product quality inspection institution or certification institution forges inspection results or issues false certificates, it shall be ordered to make corrections, and a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan shall be imposed on the institution, and a fine of not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 50,000 yuan shall be imposed on the directly responsible person in charge and other directly responsible persons; if there are illegal gains, the illegal gains shall be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, its inspection qualification or certification qualification shall be revoked; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
Where the inspection results or certificates issued by a product quality inspection institution or certification institution are untrue and cause losses, it shall bear corresponding compensation liability; if major losses are caused, its inspection qualification or certification qualification shall be revoked.
Where a product quality certification institution, in violation of the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 21 of this Law, fails to require the user of the certification mark on a product that does not meet the certification standards to correct or to revoke its right to use the certification mark according to law, it shall bear joint and several liability together with the producer and seller of the product for the losses caused to consumers due to the product's failure to meet the certification standards; if the circumstances are serious, its certification qualification shall be revoked.

Article 58 Where a social organization or social intermediary agency makes a commitment or guarantee on product quality, and the product does not meet the quality requirements as committed or guaranteed, thereby causing losses to consumers, it shall bear joint and several liability together with the producer and seller of the product.

Article 59 Whoever makes false propaganda on product quality in an advertisement to deceive or mislead consumers shall be subject to legal liability in accordance with the provisions of the Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 60 The raw and auxiliary materials, packaging materials, and production tools used by a producer exclusively for producing the products listed in Articles 49 and 51 of this Law or for passing off fakes as genuine products shall be confiscated.

Article 61 Whoever, knowing or ought to know that a product is prohibited from being produced or sold under this Law, provides transportation, custody, warehousing or other conveniences for such product, or provides production technology for counterfeiting products for passing off fakes as genuine, shall have all income derived from transportation, custody, warehousing or provision of counterfeiting production technology confiscated, and be imposed a fine of not less than 50% but not more than three times the illegal income; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 62 Where a business operator in the service industry uses a product the sale of which is prohibited under Articles 49 through 52 of this Law for operational services, it shall be ordered to cease using such product; if it knows or ought to know that the product used is one prohibited from being sold under this Law, it shall be punished in accordance with the provisions on punishment for sellers under this Law, based on the value of the products used in violation of law (including both used and unused products).

Article 63 Whoever conceals, transfers, sells, or damages articles sealed up or seized by the market supervision and administration department shall be imposed a fine of not less than the value of the articles concealed, transferred, sold, or damaged but not more than three times such value; if there are illegal gains, the illegal gains shall also be confiscated.

Article 64 Where a violator of this Law shall bear civil compensation liability and pay fines or criminal fines, if its property is insufficient to pay both at the same time, it shall first bear civil compensation liability.

Article 65 Where any staff member of a people's government at any level or any other state organ falls under any of the following circumstances, an administrative sanction shall be imposed according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law:
(1) covering up or indulging acts violating the provisions of this Law in the production or sale of products;
(2) tipping off a party engaged in production or sale activities violating the provisions of this Law, helping it to evade investigation and punishment; or
(3) obstructing or interfering with the investigation and punishment by the market supervision and administration department according to law of acts violating the provisions of this Law in the production or sale of products, causing serious consequences.

Article 66 Where the market supervision and administration department, in the random inspection of product quality supervision, demands samples in excess of the prescribed quantity or collects inspection fees from the inspected party, it shall be ordered by the superior market supervision and administration department or the supervisory organ to return them; if the circumstances are serious, the directly responsible person in charge and other directly responsible persons shall be given administrative sanctions according to law.

Article 67 Where the market supervision and administration department or any other state organ, in violation of the provisions of Article 25 of this Law, recommends a producer's product to the public or participates in product business activities by means of supervision over production or supervision over sales, it shall be ordered by its superior organ or the supervisory organ to make corrections, eliminate the adverse impact, and any illegal income shall be confiscated; if the circumstances are serious, the directly responsible person in charge and other directly responsible persons shall be given administrative sanctions according to law.
Where a product quality inspection institution commits any of the illegal acts listed in the preceding paragraph, it shall be ordered by the market supervision and administration department to make corrections, eliminate the adverse impact, and any illegal income shall be confiscated, and a fine of not more than one time the illegal income may also be imposed; if the circumstances are serious, its quality inspection qualification shall be revoked.

Article 68 Where any staff member of the market supervision and administration department abuses his power, neglects his duty, or engages in malpractice for personal gain, if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if no crime is constituted, an administrative sanction shall be given according to law.

Article 69 Whoever obstructs a staff member of the market supervision and administration department from performing his duties according to law by means of violence or threat shall be subject to criminal liability according to law; whoever refuses or obstructs without using violence or threat shall be punished by the public security organ in accordance with the provisions of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law.

Article 70 The administrative penalties prescribed in Articles 49 through 57 and Articles 60 through 63 of this Law shall be decided by the market supervision and administration department. Where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise on the organ exercising the power of administrative penalty, the provisions of the relevant laws and administrative regulations shall prevail.
Article 71 Products confiscated in accordance with the provisions of this Law shall be destroyed or disposed of by other means in accordance with the relevant provisions of the state.

Article 72 The value of the goods as prescribed in Articles 49 through 54, Article 62, and Article 63 of this Law shall be calculated on the basis of the marked price of the products illegally produced or sold; if there is no marked price, it shall be calculated on the basis of the market price of similar products.

Article 73 The measures for the supervision and administration of the quality of military industrial products shall be separately formulated by the State Council and the Central Military Commission.
Where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise on the liability for compensation for damage caused by nuclear installations or nuclear products, those provisions shall prevail.
Article 74 This Law shall come into force as of September 1, 1993.
